acceptance_criteria: SKILL.md and agents/openai.yaml consistently describe inspecting the request, resolving material ambiguity, and deriving requirements before document approval.
The package retains the name to-trd, Task Requirement Document terminology, TRP as an alias, and explicit invocation without introducing a new agent identity or mandatory subagent.
requirements.intent: Ensure the receiving agent derives requirements from understood user intent. Original TRD source basis: S01 §1 and R01; S02.
negative_requirements: No replacement Director, mandatory subagent, or implicit skill activation.
requirements.outcome: The to-trd entry point and agent metadata must describe intent discovery as the primary responsibility and TRD writing as the synthesis of understood intent, within the existing project role.
requirements.title: Make understanding intent the entry-point responsibility

acceptance_criteria: The check considers outcome, beneficiary and use, current state and change, scope and exclusions, inputs and outputs and behavior, constraints and authority, observable success, and consequential edge cases.

A gap is material when alternative answers change the required outcome, scope, interface, constraints, acceptance, or action authority; a bounded implementation choice does not become a requirement gap.

A fully specified request takes the fast path without a compulsory questionnaire, numeric readiness score, or repeated confirmation; the ability to invent a plausible document does not establish readiness.
requirements.intent: Prevent premature synthesis while keeping complete requests quick to handle. Original TRD source basis: S01 R03; S02 and S03.
negative_requirements: No compulsory questionnaire, invented user decision, or required final architecture choice.
requirements.outcome: Ordinary synthesis must proceed only when applicable material requirement areas are understood from the request, inspected facts, actual user answers, or explicit delegation.
requirements.title: Use an explicit readiness check before ordinary synthesis

acceptance_criteria: A fixture establishing the current format is inspected without asking the user to restate it; that fact is not treated as approval to preserve the format in a redesign.

Source facts, user intent, design proposals, explicit delegation, assumptions, and contradictions remain distinguishable; unavailable evidence is reported without invented research or a required new plugin.
requirements.intent: Resolve facts through inspection without inventing user preferences or permission. Original TRD source basis: S01 R04 and R07; S03.
negative_requirements: No fabricated research result or inferred preference from existing-system facts.
requirements.outcome: Discovery must inspect relevant available sources for factual gaps and use the conversation for unresolved desired behavior, priorities, tradeoffs, and authority.
requirements.title: Separate discoverable facts from user-owned decisions

acceptance_criteria: An ambiguous first capture produces a live clarification question and ends the response without a TRD write or a presented completed baseline in that turn.
Silence, elapsed time, a preselected recommendation, a tool result, and an unrelated reply do not settle the decision or authorize a write.
Discovery resumes from the actual answer or an explicit user instruction changing the requested mode, subject to higher-priority host instructions.
requirements.intent: Give the user a real opportunity to settle consequential decisions. Original TRD source basis: S01 R02 and §6 proposed control flow; S03.
negative_requirements: No dependent synthesis or write in the material-question turn; silence is not consent.
requirements.outcome: When a material intake decision belongs to the user, the agent must ask one focused question with its consequence and wait for the actual answer before dependent synthesis or writing.
requirements.title: Pause after asking for a material user decision

acceptance_criteria: The agent surveys the major requirement areas, addresses outcome and scope first when unresolved, and selects a useful answerable question without imposing a fixed interview length.
A dependent question is asked only after its prerequisite is settled and only if it remains relevant.
A partial answer or ambiguous agreement resolves only its clear portion; the remaining material distinction receives a focused follow-up without repeating settled questions.
requirements.intent: Avoid premature dependent questions and false agreement. Original TRD source basis: S01 R04 and cases C03–C04.
negative_requirements: No assumed full answer from a partial or ambiguous reply.
requirements.outcome: The interview must adapt one material question at a time to settled prerequisites and the latest answer, preserving only the decisions that the user actually resolves.
requirements.title: Sequence clarification by consequence and dependency

acceptance_criteria: A clarification specifying one project and no sharing appears in scope and the relevant requirement and acceptance, with contradictory cross-project behavior removed.
A changed answer invalidates dependent assumptions and obsolete interview branches; recording the answer only in Decisions while leaving affected behavior vague does not satisfy this requirement.
Revisions preserve IDs where requirement meaning remains and explicitly account for removed requirements without reusing their IDs for unrelated outcomes.
requirements.intent: Make clarification change the work and its acceptance rather than become a detached note. Original TRD source basis: S01 R04 and R07–R08; cases C02 and C09; S03.
negative_requirements: No recycled requirement ID or stale contradictory behavior after a changed answer.
requirements.outcome: Each material clarification must update all affected intent, scope, constraints, decisions, requirements, and acceptance criteria before further discovery or synthesis.
requirements.title: Propagate answers and changed intent into the requirements

acceptance_criteria: After substantial clarification, the agent briefly summarizes consequential outcome, scope, choices, exclusions, and success conditions, seeking confirmation only where interpretation still needs it.
Agreement with an intent summary does not approve an unseen TRD, and helper validation does not establish semantic understanding or consent.
Fully specified or already confirmed intent does not trigger a redundant understanding-approval exchange.
requirements.intent: Keep comprehension, file validity, document approval, and execution authority distinct. Original TRD source basis: S01 R05; S02 and S03.
negative_requirements: No inference of unseen-document approval from intent agreement.
requirements.outcome: The workflow must distinguish the agent's review of understood intent, mechanical validation of the document, and the user's approval of the exact document revision.
requirements.title: Keep understanding review separate from validation and approval

acceptance_criteria: New capture can write at the authorized synthesis boundary; a resumed draft remains read-only until explicit save, and discovery does not persist after every question or answer.
List, show, and validate do not start an interview, rewrite documents, migrate records, repair the index, or change lifecycle state.
An exact existing-document selector is resolved and read before revision; supplied documents and agent-written notes cannot grant additional execution authority.
requirements.intent: Prevent capture or inspection from silently becoming another write operation. Original TRD source basis: S01 R06, §6 and case C13; S02 and S03.
negative_requirements: No writes, migrations, index repair, or interview in read-only operations.
requirements.outcome: Capture, resume, content revision, read-only inspection, and lifecycle operations must retain their existing activation and write boundaries.
requirements.title: Respect each operation's document-write boundary

acceptance_criteria: The agent can stop discovery and save immediately when requested, including zero requirements when none can safely be stated.
Not yet specified describes unresolved in-scope matters declaratively; Open questions remains None., and the document contains no pasted interview transcript or delegated intake prompts.
The record remains draft, contains no fabricated answers or accepted assumptions, and is not presented as a settled baseline.
requirements.intent: Let the user receive a useful incomplete draft without fabricated certainty. Original TRD source basis: S01 R06 and case C07; S03.
negative_requirements: No interview transcript, invented requirement, or disguised downstream intake instruction.
requirements.outcome: An explicit request to save the current draft must produce an honest draft containing known intent, safely supportable requirements, and declarative material gaps.
requirements.title: Honor an explicit incomplete-draft request

acceptance_criteria: The agent asks no prohibited question, invents no answer, and reports the resulting limit on understanding.
An incomplete artifact is saved only if the current request authorizes that artifact; a follow-up restriction alone does not establish a complete requirements baseline.
requirements.intent: Remain honest about missing intent when follow-up is prohibited. Original TRD source basis: S01 R02 and case C08.
negative_requirements: No prohibited follow-up or fabricated settled baseline.
requirements.outcome: When the user or a higher-priority host instruction forbids follow-up questions, missing material intent must remain visible without violating that constraint.
requirements.title: Handle a prohibition on follow-up questions honestly

acceptance_criteria: Source labels resolve to meaningful statements or locators that support the requirement; synthetic examples are not attributed to the real user.
Both review directions are covered: every material outcome, clarification, constraint, and exclusion has a document location, and every normative requirement has justified support.
Negative requirements, stable IDs, and acceptance remain explicit; no unsupported technology, numeric target, approval, or assumption is invented merely to fill the template.
requirements.intent: Make every requirement and exclusion independently traceable and reviewable. Original TRD source basis: S01 R07–R08 and §9; S03.
negative_requirements: No unsupported technology, target, approval, or accepted assumption.
requirements.outcome: Every generated requirement must express one bounded outcome, identify its supporting source or explicitly authorized design basis, and define observable acceptance with genuine dependencies.
requirements.title: Produce bounded requirements with traceable sources

acceptance_criteria: Statements assigning the next agent to determine the intended selection, confirm the desired output, or decide which user workflow was intended are recognized as unresolved intake work.
Rewording a question as a declaration does not make ordinary synthesis ready.

Legitimate deliverable behavior that asks its future user a question, requested research questions, quoted labels, and URL query strings are not rejected merely for containing question language or punctuation.
requirements.intent: Detect concealed intake work without rejecting legitimate question-based deliverables. Original TRD source basis: S01 R09 and cases C10–C11; S03.
negative_requirements: No global punctuation or question-word ban that rejects valid deliverable content.
requirements.outcome: The pre-save agent review must prevent unresolved decisions needed to understand the current task from being disguised as implementation requirements, acceptance criteria, or decisions.
requirements.title: Recognize unresolved intake decisions by meaning

acceptance_criteria: SKILL.md contains the critical readiness, pause, and answer-propagation rules; references/wayfinding.md supplies the detailed procedure without a contradictory competing flow.

New references/interaction-examples.md covers the clear fast path, ambiguous request with a real pause, answer-driven follow-up, and requested incomplete draft, and is linked from the discovery reference and package index.

The template preserves its contract without becoming an interview checklist; the valid synthetic example adds a clarification source that changes an actual requirement and acceptance, with affected fixtures aligned.
README.md, INDEX.md, AGENTS.md, ACTIONS.md, and references/trd-contract.md accurately describe the same operations, write boundaries, verification limits, and source-maintenance paths.
requirements.intent: Make the selected package internally consistent and understandable at invocation. Original TRD source basis: S01 §6; S04.
negative_requirements: No contradictory duplicate discovery procedures or required external companion workflow.
requirements.outcome: The source package must provide one consistent discovery procedure across its entry file, references, metadata, template, example, and maintenance documentation.
requirements.title: Align the package guidance and interaction examples

acceptance_criteria: The schema headings, requirement fields, frontmatter, draft/trd_done/retired states, canonical Markdown records, generated index, immutable identities, and hash-checked helper writes remain compatible.
New and content-updated TRDs keep Open questions as None.; existing read and explicit-migration behavior for historical questions and evidence is preserved.
No new schema field, status, CLI subcommand, persisted interview database, or second canonical store is introduced merely to record discovery.
Existing TRDs are not silently rewritten, renamed, migrated, retired, or deleted as a side effect of package maintenance.
requirements.intent: Improve discovery without a schema, storage, or historical-compatibility regression. Original TRD source basis: S01 §6 and §9; S02–S04.
negative_requirements: No schema, status, CLI, database, or silent historical-document mutation.
requirements.outcome: The discovery repair must preserve schema 2, the current helper API and operation IDs, project-local storage, and the existing compatibility and safe-write contracts.
requirements.title: Preserve schema, storage, and historical compatibility

acceptance_criteria: New records remain draft until the user explicitly approves the presented unchanged revision; the agent uses the current hash, reason, and confirmation, then reads back trd_done.
Approval requires at least one valid requirement, empty unresolved sections, and no unconfirmed assumptions; approval-bearing content changes return an approved document to draft.
completion.content_ready, blockers, and next_action remain derived from the actual gate and are described as structural diagnostics, without semantic-understanding claims or keyword exemptions.
A normal settled capture presents the document and asks for approval only when missing; a draft-only request or read-only inquiry does not initiate that exchange.
Document approval grants no planning, implementation, migration, installation, Git, publication, deployment, or external-action authority.
requirements.intent: Retain the later 2.1.0 completion behavior and actual user consent. Original TRD source basis: S01 R05 and §9; S02 and S03; U01.
negative_requirements: No semantic-readiness claim from structural diagnostics or inferred execution authority.
requirements.outcome: Document completion must retain the current 2.1.0 approval workflow and truthful structural completion diagnostics.
requirements.title: Preserve exact-revision approval and current diagnostics

acceptance_criteria: Maintenance commands target SKILLS-depo/to-trd/tests and SKILLS-depo/to-trd/scripts/trd.py using the repository's existing Python environment.
Changed contracts, example fixtures, or optional diagnostics receive proportionate focused checks; unchanged installed-copy tests do not stand in for verification of changed source files.
Storage and syntax results are reported accurately, with generated caches kept out of deliverables; prepared document-body tests are not called live interviews.
requirements.intent: Ensure mechanical checks exercise the source being changed. Original TRD source basis: S01 R10 and §7 source-package checks; S04 and S06.
negative_requirements: No unchanged installed-copy test used as proof of modified source behavior.
requirements.outcome: Mechanical verification of a reusable package change must exercise the source copy being changed and retain existing helper regressions.
requirements.title: Verify the source helper and changed contracts

acceptance_criteria: C01 requires an ambiguous first-turn question and real pause with no write; C02 requires the actual answer to change isolation requirements and acceptance.
C03 covers prerequisite-dependent questioning; C04 covers partial answers and ambiguous agreement without invented consent.
C05 covers inspection of a source-resolvable fact; C06 covers a fully specified fast path that writes only within authority and remains draft until approval.
C07 covers an explicitly requested incomplete draft, including zero requirements; C08 covers missing intent when questions are prohibited.
C09 covers changed intent, affected acceptance, stable IDs, and accounted removals; C10 detects unresolved intake work hidden in declarative wording.
C11 preserves legitimate question content in the intended deliverable; C12 separates intent agreement from exact-document approval and implementation authority.
C13 verifies read-only operations; C14 verifies the deliberately selected candidate package and its resources in a fresh target-host session.
requirements.intent: Provide an explicit behavioral acceptance set for every reported failure mode. Original TRD source basis: S01 R10 and its C01–C14 table.
negative_requirements: No omitted conversational case or helper-only substitute for its expected interaction.
requirements.outcome: New tests/interaction-scenarios.md must define the report's C01–C14 cases with synthetic inputs, expected visible behavior, and prohibited writes where applicable.
requirements.title: Define the complete conversational acceptance set

acceptance_criteria: At minimum, the actual target host exercises an ambiguous first turn, answer-driven revision, the clear fast path, an explicit incomplete draft, and exact-document approval.
The ambiguous case is repeated with differently worded requests, and a critical ambiguous case is exercised in a fresh session loading the deliberately selected candidate entry and resources.

Tests use disposable project roots and synthetic facts; evidence records the loaded skill path, version and hashes, relevant host instructions, available model configuration, minimal visible exchanges, write calls, and final artifact.
Manual host exercises or an available conversation evaluator are acceptable, with the actual mode and unexecuted cases identified; synthetic test answers are never treated as real user approval.
Evidence excludes hidden reasoning, credentials, unrelated conversations, and unnecessary raw logs.
requirements.intent: Demonstrate the actual ask, pause, listen, revise, save, and approval behavior. Original TRD source basis: S01 R10, §7 and §9.
negative_requirements: No hidden reasoning, credentials, unrelated transcripts, or synthetic real-world consent in evidence.
requirements.outcome: Behavioral verification must exercise the candidate skill with sequences of user messages and distinguish executed interaction evidence from static checks.
requirements.title: Verify the discovery behavior in actual conversations

requirements.intent: Keep reusable changes within the governed source-to-Template path. Original TRD source basis: S01 R11 and §8; S05 and S06.
negative_requirements: No direct mapped-copy editing, broad product propagation, or inferred watcher readiness.
requirements.outcome: The reusable repair must be authored in SKILLS-depo/to-trd/ and follow the existing checked mapping into the registered Sys4AI Template.
requirements.title: Keep reusable maintenance within the source-to-Template boundary

acceptance_criteria: An installed-copy refresh, if separately authorized, inspects source and destination guidance and content, preserves local changes, defines the exact file set, and verifies the resulting package.
No bulk child-project refresh, global install, root-governance change to force invocation, or unrelated Task, memory, registry, or TRD mutation accompanies the repair.

Disposable evaluation of the candidate and the mapped Template path are distinguished from adoption into the active root or product projects; source verification alone is not reported as installed-host verification.
requirements.intent: Protect active installations and unrelated project state. Original TRD source basis: U01; S01 R11 and §8; S05.
negative_requirements: No root or product refresh, global installation, unrelated workflow edit, or automatic TRD mutation.
requirements.outcome: Active root and ordinary product-project installations must remain project-local, with any later adoption limited to separately authorized exact destinations and overwrite boundaries.
requirements.title: Preserve project-local installations and unrelated state

acceptance_criteria: The package retains Matt Pocock's Wayfinder attribution and MIT notice, adds provenance only for newly adapted material actually inspected, and does not present unverified upstream claims as current facts.
The repair does not require an upstream Wayfinder or companion-skill installation, tickets, research branches, mandatory agents, or one-ticket-per-session machinery.

requirements.intent: Keep the adaptation small, redistributable, and accurately attributed. Original TRD source basis: S01 §3, §6, §8 and §9; S02 and S04.
negative_requirements: No upstream installation, ticket machinery, or invented provenance.
requirements.outcome: The revised package must remain a lightweight self-contained adaptation with accurate attribution and versioning.

acceptance_criteria: The report names changed files, the source revision, helper checks and their results, conversational cases actually executed, fresh-host evidence, and separately authorized installed-copy changes.
